inputs.style: Entirely instrumental tactical historical strategy battle music, no human voice, no speech, no lyrics, no choir, no chants, no humming. 96 BPM, 4/4, D minor. Low acoustic strings in controlled rhythmic ostinatos, short pipa accents, distant Chinese barrel war drums, period military snare played softly, low brass and restrained erhu fragments. Original D F G A C motif from the menu theme transformed into resolute shorter phrases. Late nineteenth and early twentieth century Chinese railway front, urgent tactical maneuver rather than a modern cinematic trailer. Eight-bar preparation, sixteen-bar maneuver, sixteen-bar engagement, eight-bar exposed bridge, sixteen-bar renewed resolve, eight-bar measured release. Tension rises without harsh treble, explosive hits, gunfire, train noises or dialogue. Moderate game background loudness, not triumphalist bombast; clear space for rifle, artillery and UI audio.
